answer: Trust-rank with dangling-node redistribution resists sybils: PageRank-style rank flows from the honest seed, and rank that would pool in dead-end sink clusters is redistributed back to the seed rather than captured. A terrace of fakes hoarding inbound links to no onward purpose cannot bank the rank — it drains back across the ocean to the honest core. The signal of genuine two-way participation keeps rank; a sink of sybils absorbing without contributing sees its accumulated rank leak away, bounded near zero.
